title: Doesn't Cut Well
text: Doesn't Cut Well. I just used this for the first time today. As some other folks said, it really doesn't cut the ravioli very well, which makes getting them out a bit of a problem. I would have been able to give this 4 stars instead of three, if it worked better.

product_metadata.title: Palmer Regular Ravioli Mold
features: Makes 12 regular sized square ravioli 2 inches square each
Made in USA by palmer Manufacturing
description: Perfectly forms, seals and cuts 12 ravioli 2 inches square at a time, also used to make filled cookies. Wipe clean. Do not wash with soap or in dishwasher. Made in USA by renowned Palmer manufacturing.
